_readme: One entry per vendor. Fill in the fields as each program responds. 'status' controls what the site shows — leave it as 'not_applied' or 'pending' until you actually have a working link, so the site never shows a dead or non-affiliate link as if it were live.

_field_guide.status: 'not_applied' | 'pending' | 'approved' | 'no_program' — controls what shows on the site
_field_guide.site_url: vendor's plain homepage — used as fallback when no affiliate link exists yet
_field_guide.tracking_type: 'link' | 'code' | 'link_plus_code' — how this vendor actually credits you
_field_guide.affiliate_link_base: your unique referral URL once approved, e.g. https://vendor.com/?ref=yourcode — leave null until you have it
_field_guide.promo_code: your discount/tracking code, if the vendor uses one — leave null until you have it
_field_guide.cookie_days: attribution window in days, from their terms — helps you know how long a click 'counts'
_field_guide.commission: rate or structure they quote you, as text — e.g. '10% for 12 months' or '15%, tiered to 25%'
_field_guide.guidelines_notes: any required disclaimer language or restricted phrasing they send you — paste it here so it's not just sitting in an email you'll lose track of
_field_guide.last_checked: date you last confirmed the link/code actually works

UltraLife.guidelines_notes: Site references a 'Partners Portal' — check there directly for application details.
UltraLife.shipping_info: Cold-pack shipping only (overnight/2-day air). Tiered by order size: $50 (small) to $110 (251+ peptides). 1-2 day processing.
UltraLife.testing_note: Manufactured in FDA-registered, NSF-certified, GMP-compliant facilities — but no independent third-party testing lab is named, unlike several other vendors here.

Core Peptides.guidelines_notes: Strict research-only policy — expect firm required-disclaimer language if approved.
Core Peptides.shipping_info: Free over $200. Flat rate ~$9.25-9.95 standard, or $49-49.95 overnight/priority.
Core Peptides.testing_note: Independent review describes COA coverage as 'mostly, but constantly being updated with new tests' — meaning not every product is tested yet.

Koi Peptides.guidelines_notes: Runs a qualified-buyer wholesale program (labs/CROs), not a consumer affiliate program. Likely won't fit this site's model — confirm before spending more time here.
Koi Peptides.shipping_info: Free shipping over $200. Same-day dispatch before 2PM CT, Mon-Fri.
Koi Peptides.testing_note: Dual-verified: tested in-house first, then independently re-run by an accredited external lab — one of the more thorough protocols in this group.

Southern Aminos.guidelines_notes: Multiple independent review sites already have disclosed affiliate links with them, so a program almost certainly exists — worth a direct email since no public application page was found.
Southern Aminos.testing_standard: 99.5% average purity across 124 independently tracked batches
Southern Aminos.testing_note: The most externally verified of any vendor here — tracked by independent third-party sites, not just self-reported. That same tracker also logged 2 historically underdosed batches, included here for honesty rather than omitted.

Purity Peptides.guidelines_notes: Apply at https://puritypeptides.is/affiliates/apply — 24-48hr review. Research Use Only framing required sitewide.
Purity Peptides.shipping_info: Ships to US and Canada only, no international. 1-2 day processing, then 5-10 days regular or 2-4 days express.
Purity Peptides.testing_note: No testing methodology, lab, or purity standard could be confirmed from their own site.

Improved Peptides.commission: 20% first order, 10% recurring on repeat orders
Improved Peptides.guidelines_notes: Approved 2026-08-11. Research Use Only framing required sitewide — keep site copy in that lane.
Improved Peptides.shipping_info: Free standard shipping; free 2-day over $200; same-day dispatch by 3PM CT.
Improved Peptides.testing_note: Real batch results published (e.g. BPC-157 99.18%, GLP-3R 99.96%) — though some COAs are still listed as 'in verification,' not yet downloadable.

Royal Peptides.guidelines_notes: Approved 2026-08-11. Site sells several actual prescription pharmaceuticals (HCG, HGH/Somatropin, Sildenafil) and SARMs (MK-677, Ostarine) alongside research peptides — those are deliberately excluded from the comparison, not just the usual TB-500/investigational-drug flags. Research Use Only framing required for everything that IS listed.
Royal Peptides.payment_note: No credit cards accepted (confirmed via their Terms of Service).
Royal Peptides.shipping_info: 2-5 business days via UPS from California. Exact cost not published.
Royal Peptides.testing_note: Their own FAQ hedges: testing 'may include' HPLC/MS 'depending on the batch and documentation available' — less definitive than their marketing tagline implies.

BioIntegrity Research.guidelines_notes: Real, verified company — DBA of Triple Seven Distribution LLC. Publishes a public COA archive (strong trust signal). NOT the same as the 'BioIntegrity' name in the original spreadsheet, which remains unverified — do not conflate the two. No affiliate program contact made yet.
BioIntegrity Research.shipping_info: Calculated at checkout by weight/destination; cold-chain packaging included free. 2-3 day processing, ships via USPS/UPS/FedEx.
BioIntegrity Research.testing_note: Publishes a genuinely unusual permanent public COA archive (38 lots across 23 compounds, even sold-out ones) — but the testing lab isn't named, so independent/third-party status is unconfirmed.
